supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded creation of ext.rwong at 13:44:07 UTC by nora.blake, matching the documented ext.<name> temporary-account naming pattern used by help desk.
The creation event's subject logon ID matches nora.blake's network logon to the domain controller from WS-NBLAKE-01 shortly beforehand.
A subsequent domain-controller event records ext.rwong being added to the Freelancers group, consistent with the documented temporary-account workflow.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for the proxy host were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC because of an outage; proxy activity in that interval cannot be assessed from those logs.
The supplied records do not include the contents of any Zeek events, despite Zeek sensor coverage being reported as available.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish whether the account was requested or approved for a specific business need.
The records do not establish ext.rwong's eventual use, expiration, or complete group membership.
The proxy collection outage prevents determining whether relevant web activity occurred during the affected interval.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect's UI launched on WS-NBLAKE-01 and loaded a signed Cisco DLL. This is separate from the account creation; these records do not show that a VPN connection was made. Review under a separate ticket because the environment states there is no VPN.
